---
name: release-checklist
description: "Prepare or review a Gate-OS release with tests, ISO evidence, SBOM, signatures, licenses, notes, and rollback instructions."
---

Use `release-signing-and-ota` and `qemu-boot-testing`. Verify version consistency, clean build, tests/coverage, security and license approvals, BIOS/UEFI/install evidence, checksums/signatures, SBOM, upgrade notes, and truthful release claims.
